{"title": "Pop-up Didn’t Pop-up", "text": "I purchased this pop-up gift box last year and thought it was so cute, so I bought another one this year. Unfortunately, the pop-up insert was damaged and didn’t pop up. It was coming out and I had to tape it back in, plus it was bent. I’m sure my son won’t care as it’s what the box is holding that is the actual gift, but *I* care. Just disappointed it arrived damage."}
